text:
lucy: heads up — noticed a tail-latency spike on /v1/embeddings this morning correlated with mixed seq_len workloads. p50 fine, p99 up ~3x for a subset of tenants.

derek: any idea which routers or routes?

lucy: looks like router-A vlan-3, lots of small short inputs (32-64) mixed with long ones (512+). router's batcher kept forcing small-batch execution on hosts with lower batch cap. saw ~40% fallback to shape-degraded model variants.

marta: oof. is this the prefetch change from last week?

lucy: possibly — we toggled the prefetch heuristics on canary at 03:10 UTC. tiny signal in canary but production amplifies with mixed-tenants.

ash: can someone link the console timeseries? I want to see batch size distribution vs seq_len.

lucy: dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/d/embeds/seqlen-batch-eff?org=infra (it has per-route histograms). quick snapshot: batch_count drops while batch_latency climbs for affected hosts.

kevin: can we get tenant-level batching_efficiency metric? current telemetry is per-host only.

marta: yes we should. propose: emit embed.batch_efficiency{tenant,route} = summed_tokens / (max_batch * actual_batches) — rough but meaningful.

derek: also add embed.shape_fallbacks{tenant,route} increment when we down-prioritize kv-cache or use quantized variant due to shape. need SLO alert.

lucy: can we avoid routing small+large together? routing policy idea: prefer routing by dominant seq_len bucket for the request window, or split tenant streams into homogeneous lanes. low risk canary: prefer-homogenous=true flag at router.

ash: quick probe: how many tenants would be affected if we pin by dominant bucket? is there a churn/latency cost?

lucy: rough count ~120 tenants produce >20% mixed traffic. cost — extra cross-shard traffic for multi-bucket fans, but reduced inefficient small-batch executions.

kevin: need UX on console: show per-tenant "batch loss" metric and ability to pin routing policy per-tenant from UI. Product will want guardrails (opt-in for 30 days).

marta: agree. for rollout: (1) emit metrics (batch_eff, shape_fallbacks), (2) add router flag behind FF, (3) expose per-tenant toggle in console, (4) canary 10% tenants for 24h.

derek: rubber duck check — metrics emitted to prod with low-cardinality first (route, bucket) then tenant. avoid high-card cost spike.

lucy: code snippet for new metric emission (pseudo):
```
emit.metric("embed.batch_efficiency", tags={"route": r, "seq_bucket": b}, value=tokens_processed / (b.max_batch * batches) )
```

ash: nice. for alerts: p99_latency_increase && batch_efficiency_drop => paging oncall? maybe create a runbook entry.

kevin: I'll add console toggle mockup to the design doc and wire to the feature flag API.

marta: heads-up to billing — if we change routing we might shift cost profile per-tenant; notify finance before full rollout.

derek: can we schedule a 30-min sync today to align infra/product/ops?

lucy: yes 11:30 UTC works for me.

sre-bot: incident-created: INC-2026-884 (investigating embedding routing inefficiency).
